trial_court: Metropolitan Magistrate, Traffic Court-III, Bengaluru. Crl. Mis. No.206/2014
case_name: Smt. Paramita Halder W/O Subharajyothi vs Mr. Subharajyoti Halder S/O Tapan

parties.respondent_defendant: Mr. Subharajyoti Halder S/o Tapan, Tapan Kumar Halder S/o Late Birendranath Halder, Bulurani Halder W/o Tapan Kumar Halder, Bebojyoti Halder S/o Tapan Kumar, Anuradha Halder W/o Debojyoti Halder (husband and family members)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The petitioner sought various reliefs under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005. The case is about a marriage that took place in 2008 and the petitioner claimed that her husband and family members were not providing her with valuable things belonging to her.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to prove that the allegations of domestic violence are false.
legal_principles.held: Further, the respondent no.1 had filed his objections, thereafter the respondent nos. 2 to 5 have filed petition before Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka and said application was allowed.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: A party's indifference or lack of interest in the other party's financial status can be a factor in determining the existence of domestic violence.
legal_principles.held: The respondent no.1 was shocked to see the indifferent attitude of the petitioner immediately after marriage.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005
use_in: cases involving domestic violence and financial disputes

outcome.final_order: The court granted various reliefs to the petitioner under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
